title: HELM: A Human-Centered Evaluation Framework for LLM-Powered Recommender Systems

bias_targets.methodology: Measured using the Gini coefficient to evaluate inequality in item recommendation frequency and Coverage@100 to assess the proportion of catalog items appearing in the top-100 recommendations.
Evaluated through expert ratings assessing whether recommendation quality and relevance are consistent across different demographic groups in specific evaluation scenarios.
Assessed by measuring whether items receive equitable exposure opportunities, evaluated alongside popularity using automated metrics like the Gini coefficient and catalog coverage.
